text:
Sam: FYI opened PR #8720 to fix broken internal links in the migration guide + update one SDK snippet. Need reviewer cover.
Iris: link? I can take a quick pass on the migration guide tonight.
Sam: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8720 - linkcheck failed in preview.
docs-bot: Preview failed: docs/link-check for PR #8720, logs: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/8001
Tom: I can help with the snippet run tomorrow morning. Which SDK?
Sam: JS/TS quickstart. The snippet expects new client signature; tests fail locally complaining about missing param.
Marta: Quick request: we have a docs rota gap today (Iris out after 5pm). Can someone else pick reviewer slot after Iris?
Iris: I'll review before 5pm and tag who should pick it up after.
Sam: I pushed a tiny fix for one relative link; still failing one external anchor.
Tom: External anchor often needs a redirect update. I can check with web infra tomorrow. For the snippet, if it's a signature change we should add a short migration note instead of changing every example at once.
Marta: +1 on migration note. Also suggest adding a short test to snippet-runner to accept the old/new signature during the transition.
Iris: review done; left one editorial nit and approved the link fix. Tagging @Tom for SDK review.
docs-bot: Preview queued again after push.
Sam: thanks Iris. @Marta can you pick merge verification if CI passes after 17:30 PT?
Marta: I can do 17:45 PT.
Tom: I'll run snippet tests at 08:30 PT tomorrow and post results. If infra needs to update redirects, I'll file a follow-up issue.
docs-bot: CI passed for PR #8720: link-check , snippet-tests . Preview: https://preview.redwood.dev/pr/8720
Sam: merging now during 18:00 PT merge window. Thanks all.
Marta: merged and followed up with reindex job. closing reviewer gap.
